name: Bourscheid in a day
description_md:
Bourscheid in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights in LU. The route covers 10.4 km of walking between stops and takes about 6.5 hours for the full day, visit time at each stop included.

The day is anchored in Bourscheid. Walkers stop at 4 sightseeing stops along the way.
